## Role fit and evidence

- Target: junior IT support, helpdesk and entry-level systems support; developing cybersecurity skills.
- Systems: Windows, Linux and virtual machines for system setup, networking and troubleshooting practice.
- Home lab: Raspberry Pi with Pi-hole; installed coreboot on a personal ThinkPad using Raspberry Pi and Skulls instructions.
- Programming: Python, SQL and Git; C# fundamentals.
- Cryplab: Python CLI with SHA-256 text/file hashing, chunked file reads, AES-256-GCM text encryption and key export. This is a personal learning project.
- Retro Forum: Next.js/Prisma/SQLite project with bcrypt password checks, JWT sessions and login attempt limits. Public source is available for review.
- Documentation: three educational case notes about phishing triage, DNS/ICMP troubleshooting and SYN flooding, with evidence and investigation limitations.
- Work background: H2B school placements in March–April 2024 and March–April 2025, handling documents and administrative tasks; additional warehouse/merchandising work, including reports.
- Education: Pomorskie Szkoły Rzemiosł, programming track completed in 2026; INF.03 passed.
- Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate: {{course_status}}.
- Languages: Polish native; English B2.
